title: Rand Paul confronts Fauci over the gain-of-function definition

tellings.quote: So what you're doing is defining away gain of function. You're simply saying it doesn't exist because you changed the definition on the NIH website.

plain: In 2021, at a hearing in the US Senate in Washington, Senator Rand Paul confronted Anthony Fauci, the government's top infectious disease official, about gain-of-function research, work that makes viruses more contagious or dangerous. Paul says Fauci was defining gain of function away, claiming it did not exist simply because the definition had been changed on the website of the NIH, the main US medical research agency. If true, it would mean officials reworded the rules to avoid admitting to risky research, and the story is retold as an example of how government can hide things by changing words.
